_comment: yay Auto Private DNS. wifi_host = your personal NextDNS endpoint (e.g. abc123.dns.nextdns.io). mobile_host = used on mobile data (Cloudflare passes carrier SNI/DPI filters). When Wi-Fi and mobile data are both up, prefer decides (cellular|wifi). Manual Private DNS changes are respected until it is set back to one of these two profiles or the device reboots.
